log.msg: Finding 1: added sources to public/framework/page.js's children: list. /framework/sources/ now loads (confirmed 200 + sidebar entry via a fresh screenshot).

Finding 2: all four ext/DesignTool/doc/file/*.js.md links fixed from ../../docs/... to ../../doc/... (mirror.js.md, live.js.md, probe.js.md, report.js.md). Confirmed the target doc pages return 200 (e.g. GET .../doc/addressing/ -> 200).

Finding 3: rewrote sources/page.js's topic_page() to use ext/files' files() browser (tree + about + source panels) instead of a wall of cards, exactly like ext/Doc's own Files tab. about() shows the badge row (authority/kind/url) then the stripped, converted markdown; the tree's paths come straight from each topic's index.jsonl 'path' field. Removed the now-unused source_page() leaf-route function (files()'s own ?file= query replaces the separate per-source URLs). Added two lines of CSS under the already-reserved sources- prefix (Sources.css) to size the browser full-width, mirroring Doc.css's .doc-files exactly. Verified live: /framework/sources/ still shows the topic wall as cards, /framework/sources/opencode/ now shows the three-panel browser, and it looks the same shape as ext/DesignTool's own /files/ tab side by side (screenshots saved, see below).

Finding 4: confirmed both public/framework/ai/2026/09/25/ and public/framework/core/Page/jsonl/readme.md already exist independently of this task. Traced the actual mechanism: Server/plugins/PageFiles.js watches the filesystem and appends exactly these {"file":...} lines to a page.jsonl whenever it notices a real file/folder that isn't listed yet -- including a 'boot catch-up' scan every time a server starts. I removed both lines by hand and the running dev server put them straight back within seconds (twice, reproduced) -- this is the server's own steady-state bookkeeping, not something this task's code wrote, and it will keep re-appearing as long as any server watches this tree (my own test server included). Leaving both lines in place as the live-correct state rather than fighting an automatic process; answered 'not-a-bug' in the parent task.jsonl.

Finding 6: traced every real caller of Page.child() in the live app (core/Router/Router.js's load_segments -- real navigation -- and Page.class.js's load_all_children(), which only ever calls child() with names already in this.children.keys()). 'docs' is deliberately never a real declared key, so load_all_children() can never pass it to child() and trigger Doc's redirect outside an actual '/docs/...' url in the address bar. Found no reproducible path where the guard is needed; left Doc.js unchanged per the brief's own instruction not to guess at a fix for a bug I can't reproduce.

Finding 7: folded into finding 3's rewrite -- the new source_about() fetch checks res.ok before .text() (matching read_jsonl()'s own guard) and shows 'Not found: <path>' in the about panel instead of rendering 404 HTML as markdown.

Finding 9: sources/readme.md's dead /Server/sources.mjs link now points at https://github.com/lew42/monorepo/blob/main/Server/sources.mjs (checked: origin remote is github.com/lew42/monorepo, default branch main) with a line noting it's a repo link, not a site page.

Finding 10: added the sources- prefix reservation to public/framework/styles/css-scopes.txt, at the end of the file in the same 'registered later' style as the other out-of-band entries (v2-, v3-, etc.), naming the .sources-badge classes and the new .sources-files layout class from finding 3's fix.

Screenshots saved at public/framework/ai/2026-09-28/source-library/review-fixes/shots/: sources-library-1920.png (the library front page, topic wall) and sources-opencode-topic-1920.png (the opencode topic page in its new files-browser shape). Compared by eye against http://source-library.localhost/framework/ext/DesignTool/files/ -- same tree/about/source panel layout. Started this worktree's own dev server on its assigned port (56175) to verify all of this live; left it running for the mastermind/owner to check at http://source-library.localhost/.

assign.outcome:
**All 8 assigned review findings closed (1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 7, 9, 10); findings 5 and 8 left for the mastermind, as the brief said.**

- [/framework/sources/](/framework/sources/) — the library front page, fixed (finding 1: `sources` was never in `page.js`'s `children:`, so it 404'd).
- [/framework/sources/opencode/](/framework/sources/opencode/) — a topic page, rebuilt to use the same tree + about + source browser as [ext/DesignTool's own Files tab](/framework/ext/DesignTool/files/) (finding 3), instead of a wall of cards. The topic wall itself is untouched — still cards, on purpose.
- Finding 2: the four stale `docs/` links in `ext/DesignTool/doc/file/*.js.md` now point at `doc/`.
- Finding 7: folded into finding 3 — the browser's `about` panel checks `res.ok` before rendering a source, so a missing `.md` says "Not found" instead of showing the site's 404 page as markdown.
- Finding 9: `sources/readme.md`'s dead `/Server/sources.mjs` link now points at the file on GitHub.
- Finding 10: `sources-` is now reserved in `styles/css-scopes.txt`.
- Finding 4 (investigated, not fixed because there was nothing to fix): the two stray-looking `page.jsonl` lines are `Server/plugins/PageFiles.js`'s own live bookkeeping — I removed them by hand and the running dev server put them back within seconds, twice. Answered `not-a-bug`.
- Finding 6 (investigated, left alone): traced every real caller of `Page.child()` in the live app and found none that could pass `"docs"` outside a real `/docs/...` navigation. Answered `no-repro`, per the brief's own instruction not to guess at a fix for a bug I can't reproduce.

![the opencode topic page in its new files-browser shape](shots/sources-opencode-topic-1920.png)

Left alone, per the brief: finding 5 (the proof write-up) and finding 8 (the fan-out's judgment call) — both explicitly the mastermind's to handle.
